visible_prompt_profile.reviewed_by: Codex root public TinyDB API and source-bound actual run001 behavior review2026-10-25
visible_prompt_profile.curated_prompt:
TinyDB can return a document from a repeated query even after that document has been deleted.

Reproduce with a table containing one matching document: run a query, remove the document by its ID, then repeat the same query. The stored table is empty and the repeated query should return an empty list. This should work with both MemoryStorage and JSONStorage, while preserving ordinary inserts, updates, and nonempty query behavior.
visible_prompt_profile.source_basis: Actual source-bound run001 MemoryStorage observation, public query/remove API contract and unchanged source test specification; no reference edit or required-ID list supplied in the prompt.

tasks.mechanism_evidence: rpartial forwards caller positional args before its bound tail and lets call-time keywords override bound defaults. Preserve context object identity while constructing the final consumer call. Secondary callable-partial context is acknowledged; the repaired contract is parameter placement and precedence, distinct from Call capture and function metadata.
